Apply to Sparked Live

Two minutes. A person reads every one of these.

Apply on TikTok See how it works

Goes straight to TikTok's own application form for our network. No invitation code needed.

Email your application

Tell us this much

  • Your TikTok handle
  • Roughly how many days and hours you go LIVE in a normal month
  • What you stream — gaming, music, just chatting, PK battles (head-to-head matches against another creator), something else
  • Whether you are currently signed with another TikTok LIVE network
  • That you are 18 or older and based in the United States
  • The single thing you most want help with right now
Applying from outside our official TikTok account? TikTok will ask you for a 6-character invitation code. It lives in the app and takes about thirty seconds to find — here is a video showing exactly where. It expires after 24 hours, so grab it when you are ready to send.

What happens next

We review your handle and recent LIVE activity, then reply either way — usually within a few days. If we are a fit, you get an invitation through TikTok's official LIVE Backstage system, which is the only way a creator can legitimately join a network. You accept it from inside the TikTok app. Nobody will ever ask you for a password.

Safety note. A real network never asks for your TikTok password, never charges a joining fee, and never takes a cut of your diamonds. If anyone claiming to be us does any of those things, they are not us — email tiktok@dcassociatesgroup.com and tell us.
